device_id.description: identifiers.adoc, device_id; unique in the store, never reused.

label.description: From the label given at pairing, else the device_id; local for a device paired through pm-operator web open; renamed by the operator in either client; display only.

paired_by.description: The verb that issued the redeemed pairing code (the terminal client's entry issues codes as pair does). While the store holds a device with open, pm-operator web open opens the app without pairing again (cli-and-security, web-open).

paired_from.description: The listener the pairing was redeemed on.

secret_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 device secret (pmw_...); the secret itself is returned once at pairing and never stored.

last_used_at.description: Last authenticated request, written at most once per write interval (timeouts.adoc#device-last-used-granularity); older than the device idle expiry (timeouts.adoc#device-idle-expiry) expires the device.
